title: Ais-Rating-Menu ssr problems.
body:
**Bug 🐞**

### What is the current behavior?

Ais-Rating-Menu not working as expected.

Several observations:
Menu not selectable/links not working.
Seems to get out of sync due to SSR.

Enter via root. Navigate to search. Rating works as expected.
Refresh page. Rating no longer works.
Also, if you navigate to the search page via url in browser (localhost:3000/search) Rating doesn't work.

### Make a sandbox with the current behavior

https://github.com/jaylingelbach/uvue-sandbox

### What is the expected behavior?

Rating always works no matter how you get there.

### Does this happen only in specific situations?

Yes. Via url navigation or refresh.

### What is the proposed solution?

Investigate ssr with rating menu in Vue.

### What is the version you are using?

latest

> Always try the latest one before opening an issue.
